mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_insights (stock_code, content, sources, generated_at) VALUES (#{stockCode}, #{content}, #{sources, typeHandler=com.bluemoon.backend.mapper.handler.InsightSourceListTypeHandler}, #{generatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, stock_code, content, sources, generated_at FROM ai_insights WHERE stock_code = #{stockCode} ORDER BY generated_at DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ai_insights WHERE generated_at >= #{threshold}) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM DUAL

SELECT a.id, a.stock_code, a.content, a.sources, a.generated_at FROM ai_insights a INNER JOIN ( SELECT stock_code, MAX(generated_at) AS max_generated_at FROM ai_insights GROUP BY stock_code ) latest ON a.stock_code = latest.stock_code AND a.generated_at = latest.max_generated_at
